title: Uses a Chinese language as default
body:

title: 日志不能自动保存（已解决）
body:
优点： 界面清新，功能简单。 唯一难以忍受的bug 是： 在编辑日志状态如果切换到其它APP，哪怕只有一秒钟，再回来程序就退出并重新加载了。更可怕的是打卡日志竟没有自动保存功能！！！于是只要在编辑过程中离开，就全白写了。好几次当我记录大半的读书笔记或者菜谱不翼而飞后，我真气的想摔手机。 请开发者务必改进。谢谢。

09.08.2021 UPDATE:

问题已解决。感谢。

title: A cute app to track your habits
body:
I have used many habits tracking app and so far this one is my most favourite. The reason is simple, I love its UI with all these cute little icons. It’s super easy to use with no complication.

One suggestion I would like to comment though: Could the developer add a feature to comment/write a log each time we fail to complete a habit? For example, if I cannot exercise on a particular day for some reasons, I would like to write down that reason to review later. We already have a log when completing a habit but I think a log for not completing one is equally useful for building habits.

Thanks for reading my review and suggestion.

title: Gorgeous app
body:
Gorgeous app. I highly appreciate the efforts the developer has taken to enhance the customisable functions; this app can be altered in almost every way possible, including icons, the different times of day, and fonts, just to name a few. It’s the customisable version of Google Calendar we have all been looking for! 

I avoid subscriptions at all costs so the full-featured premium option for one-time-only amount of AUD $4.49 is more than reasonable. Even the free version has full functions, which is a rarity in this time and age where we are pressured to purchase premium versions right away. 

Beautiful app. Adorable interface, can’t recommend enough.
